visualCharacteristics.notes: 16:9 poster still with a large centered circular play button; the YouTube/Vimeo/file player replaces the poster only when the play button is clicked (no third-party scripts up front). Sits in the narrow article column.

contentPattern.structure: one row, one cell: poster picture (optional) + link to the video URL (YouTube, Vimeo or .mp4/.webm). Link text other than the URL is used as the video title for the play button aria-label and iframe title; otherwise the poster alt text is used

suitableFor: click-to-play YouTube or Vimeo videos with a poster still
story/article page videos (Sitecore video video-promo component)
self-hosted mp4/webm videos with a poster
notSuitableFor: autoplaying background videos (use video with autoplay)
